meta.description: Labels for systemData.shopRecordList Type ids, matched from where each table's stock is sold.
meta.source: https://essenceofsaga.wordpress.com/home/book-index/item-selling/ - item-by-item sale locations, retrieved 2026-10-29; shop grouping cross-checked against https://steamcommunity.com/app/1295270/discussions/0/3109152828471163523/
meta.method: A label is assigned only when every item in the table's fixed stock list is documented as sold at that location. The game itself has no shop-name table: global-metadata.dat contains ShopRecord, ShopItemRecord and ShopType, but no shop name strings, so these are location and stock labels rather than in-game names.
meta.confidence_rule: high = the whole stock list is sold only at that location, or the combination is unique to it; medium = the location is shared with another gold seller and the contents cannot distinguish them.
meta.unmapped_rule: A Type missing here falls back to 'Shop table N' in the viewer. Do not add a label without item-level sale evidence.
meta.grouping: Each entry carries a location (town or area) used to group stock tables in the viewer's Still to buy list; label is 'location - stock'. A Type without a location is grouped under Unlabelled tables.

0.label: Koorong - Boots
0.basis: LeatherBoots, RubberShoes, JetBoots and FeatherBoots are sold in Koorong and nowhere else.

1.label: Kyo - Misc
1.basis: Every item is sold in Kyo; the coins, amulets and Budowear are Kyo-only, and the full set does not fit Omble or Magic Kingdom.

2.label: Shrike - Nakajima Robotics
2.basis: RepairKit and the seven Mec weapons are all Shrike stock; RepairKit is also sold in Junk and Scrap, but the combination is Shrike-only.

3.label: Manhattan - Accessory
3.basis: PearlHeart, the three crystals, HarmoniumEarring, BloodChalice, PurpleEye and WonderBangle are all Manhattan-only.

4.label: Koorong - Recovery items
4.basis: All seven items are sold in Koorong; Omble and Junk stock subsets, but Koorong is the only place that sells the whole list.

5.label: Junk - Misc
5.basis: Cure through SnakeOil plus RepairKit, HyperBlaster and GrainCannon is the Junk stock; Koorong and Omble carry only part of it.

6.label: Magic Kingdom - Misc
6.basis: Magicwear, BoltCrystal, Magi-Water, XMagi-Drink, MagicStone and RuneSword are all sold in the Magic Kingdom; the full set is unique to it.

7.label: Koorong - Guns
7.basis: The eight AGUNI and rifle models are sold in Koorong and nowhere else.

8.label: Koorong - Swords
8.basis: All eight swords are Koorong stock; RuneSword is also sold in the Magic Kingdom and ZeroSword in Nelson, but the combination is Koorong-only.

9.label: Koorong - Armor
9.basis: The six vests and suits plus ArmorGlove and CyberGlove are all Koorong-only.

10.label: Koorong - Helms
10.basis: JunkHelm, YolkHat, FiberHood, InfraScope, LaserScope and MirrorGlass are all Koorong-only.

11.label: Luminous - Omble
11.basis: The three cures plus MagicStone, ShadowDagger and DarkRobe is the Omble stock; Koorong, Junk and Magic Kingdom sell only parts of it.

12.label: Koorong - Heavy weapons
12.basis: Flame Thrower through HyperBlaster are all sold in Koorong; GrainCannon and HyperBlaster are also Junk stock. The vendor inside Koorong is not identified by any source, so the label names the stock rather than a shopkeeper.

13.label: Nelson - Weapon/Armor
13.basis: Buckler, ShellShield and WarLordArmor are Nelson-only; ZeroSword is also sold in Koorong, but the full set is the Nelson shop.

14.label: Koorong - Gold Exchange
14.basis: Only GoldIngot. Koorong and Nelson are the two documented gold sellers, and the contents cannot distinguish them; 14 is the low id inside the standard 0-14 range, which is the basis for assigning Koorong here.

60.label: Facinaturu - LP items
60.basis: Asura, Tao-TiehPattern, ShadeRobe and SandVessel are the four items bought with max LP in Facinaturu.

90.label: Nelson - Gold Ingot
90.basis: Only GoldIngot. Assigned to Nelson because 90 sits outside the standard 0-14 range, unlike the Koorong gold table at 14; contents cannot distinguish the two.
